When Chloe's goodness threatens to drain the Anti-Fairy World Wand, Foop disguises himself as a girl in order to break Chloe; Timmy takes Chloe to meet Mark Chang so he can prove that aliens really do exist.

Wanda switches Timmy's brain with his mother's brain; Crocker decides to start hunting leprechauns instead of fairies.
Vicky uses underhanded tactics to try to win a beauty pageant; Timmy wishes that he can read people's minds.
Timmy wishes that the whole world could be like his Crimson Chin comic book.
Timmy wishes that Tom Sawyer could come out of his book and help him with his book report.
Timmy offers to baby-sit so that Cosmo and Wanda can have a night out; Timmy wishes for indestructible hair.
Crocker tries to trigger Sparky with a secret word; Catman confuses Sparky with his arch-nemesis, Dogman.
SpongeBob and Patrick visit a retirement home; SpongeBob loses his confidence.
SpongeBob must protect the town from a ferocious biker gang; Mr. Krabs and Plankton work together to infiltrate a new smoothie shop.
Timmy wishes to eliminate rules; an old friend visits Timmy.
After Timmy and Chloe save Dark Laser's beloved pet, Dark Laser becomes bound to them as their bodyguard; Timmy and Chloe wish up a girlfriend for Mr. Crocker to get him off their backs.
Timmy helps his parents relive their days as ghostbusters; Timmy wishes his parents were the best surfers ever while on vacation in Hawaii.
Wanda gives Timmy a magic photocopier; the police mistakenly think Timmy's parents are dangerous outlaws.
Timmy's friends get tired of how he treats them; Timmy wishes that he has no feelings.
Dad starts a neighborhood watch program; Timmy tries to win a contest by wishing that he had the perfect family.
Timmy goes to the hospital to have his tonsils removed; Timmy wishes to see his favorite baseball team.
An evil dentist steals the teeth of a teen singing sensation; Timmy travels back in time to the Old West.

When Cosmo loses the wands after Timmy and Chloe switch places, they risk being stuck as each other; Timmy and his father have some time to bond when they enter a film festival, but things get out of hand when Dad casts Catman.
Dad goes back to school in Timmy's fifth grade; Timmy steals Jorgen's grandmother's secret recipe for brownies.
Timmy discovers a plot to destroy the Crimson Chin's reputation; Timmy wishes for access to Vicky's diary.
Timmy wishes that his parents had some new friends; Timmy wishes that he and Trixie were the only two people on Earth.
Sparky is forbidden from dating Dinkleberg's new dog; Timmy wishes all women away to end Mom's constant nagging.
60fb01a24795a6000762fe83: It's "Hands Off Day!" a city holiday, where the entire city doesn't use their hands for anything. A nature documentary crew follows Billionaire Fendrich as if he was an animal in the wild.

The ninja face off with an exhibit of a Stone Samurai Warrior that the toxic venom from the Great Devourer has brought to life while Garmadon manages to find a fabled Dark Island that is said to hold dark powers.

The ninja try to flee from the rest of the Stone Army that has been brought to life by the Devourer’s toxic venom - and things get a lot worse when Garmadon arrives with a ‘Helmet of Darkness’ and seizes control of the Stone Army.

The Ninjas, Lloyd, Sensei Wu and Misako journey to the Dark Island to find a ‘Temple of Light’ that can restore the Ninjas’ elemental powers but are attacked by Starteeth (barnacle-like star fish) that start eating through their ship.

After battling off Garmadon’s Stone Army, the Ninjas finally arrive at the Temple of Light where they harness their pure elemental powers, concentrating them onto Lloyd who becomes more powerful than he ever imagined.

When the Ninjas’ attempt to return Garmadon’s ‘Helmet of Darkness’ to its perch at the Celestial Clock in order to prevent the final battle between Lloyd and his father from beginning fails, a Super Weapon is created that can destroy all of Ninjago.
When Garmadon uses his new Super-Weapon to turn Jamakai Village evil, he unwittingly unsettles the balance, allowing the spirit of the Overlord to cross over and possesses his body.
With Mysterium under attack, Ras, Arin and Sora rely on the Sorceress for help, while Jay leads the Ninja to the Administration on their way to Lee.
Lloyd, Jay, Nya and Wyldfyre go undercover in the strange Land of Lee, while Riyu's training under Rontu is off to a bumpy start.
The Underworld tests Arin and Sora's commitment to Ras, while Nya and Jay work together to expose Lee's secret.
Cole, Frak and Kai unearth a shocking discovery outside the Land of Lost Things, while the Ninja reunite to liberate Lee.
The Ninja escape Lee and head for the source of the threat, while Ras plans his next move.

A great darkness has fallen upon Ninjago as Garmadon’s Super-Weapon has turned it evil but Lloyd and the Ninjas discover that light is more powerful than dark - and the final and ultimate battle is on.

After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd.
The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord’s evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go.

The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd.

The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas’ search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd.

Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive
Lloyd is free but Pythor and the Overlord are nowhere to be found. However the Ninja have a cryptic clue to their next plan - something called Codename: Arcturus. But what is it?

Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction

In the City of Temples, the Ninja find guidance from an unlikely source, while Cole, Kai and Frak battle the Hollow Ones in Imperium.
The Ninja embark on their separate journeys to awaken the Arc Dragon of Focus but deal with unexpected - and annoying - interruptions.
The Ninja reach the Caves of Bells while Lloyd and Arin fight their way through the Spectral Lands to summon the Arc Dragon.
ThunderFang gathers the last of his power in the Spectral Lands and only the Ninja can stop him - but at what cost?
The Ninja find themselves scattered across the Merged Lands and encounter new threats in their search for a way home.
The young Ninja struggle to find a way out of paradise, while Lloyd and Jay separately grapple with who they are meant to be.
Jay finds a lead to his lost memories while Frak's team aids the Explorer's Club in a monster hunt, and Loyalists draw closer to their goal.

Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton.  But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody’s in town.  Then, they hear…laughter?!

We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay.  He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it.  And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.”
The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form.
A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud and is raising an army of lightning-infused Stone Monsters.
Sora's team deals with the fallout of a monster attack, and Jay draws closer to restoring his memories.
Both Riyu and Lloyd undergo trials that might change them forever, while the Loyalist plot draws close to home in Ninjago.
Jay, Kai and Nya find themselves in more danger while escaping the Administration, and the Ninja must defend the Whispering Wood during Lloyd's trial.
Sora and Frak must unmask the Loyalist in Umbrasylvis to clear their name. Meanwhile, Lloyd confronts his past inside the temple.
Cole tries to deliver a setback to the Loyalists' plan, while Lloyd faces the ultimate test within the Temple of the Green Ninja.
63fe2ec4dff38e000835f786: Itʼs “back to basics” for 15 Division when Staff Sergeant Frank Best decides itʼs time for his officers to get back on track
A seasonʼs worth of trials and tribulations come to a head during a frenzied night at the station when the distracted rookies improperly search a prisoner
When a violent child abductor escapes from an emergency hospital visit, 15 Division goes on the hunt for the criminal -- only to discover that heʼs taken another young victim

After six months working undercover, Andy and Nick’s operation goes sideways when Nick, then Andy go missing. Meanwhile, a random arrest at 15 Division puts Sam Swarek and the other officers in the middle of the investigation-turned-rescue-mission

On her first day back at 15 Division, Andy must work with Swarek to track down an ex convict determined to get his old life back at any cost. Andy realizes just how much has changed since she walked away from her old life six months ago

Andy is partnered with Swarek’s new girlfriend, Officer Marlo Cruz. When they come face-to-face with an out of control EDP [Emotionally Disturbed Person], their differences are put to the test and one of them has to pull the trigger.
Rookie Blue: The Kids Are Not Alright

Andy has her sights set on a much-needed long weekend. But when a routine highway check leads to the discovery of a teenage boy in the trunk of a car, Andy and Gail must convince him that no heartache lasts forever

After a messy drug arrest, Andy and Marlo are quarantined together. Meanwhile, 15 Division springs into emergency response mode in order to get the contaminated drugs off the streets before a deadly outbreak sweeps through the city.

When a young woman is reported missing, the officers of 15 Division soon discover a possible copycat connection to one of their division’s most distressing cases. With the clock ticking, Gail must face her worst fears..
When human bones found in a ravine open up a 15-year-old missing persons case, Swarek reunites with his old training officer to solve the case
Rookie Blue: For Better, For Worse

Everyone at 15 Division, especially Andy, just wants a quick, smooth shift so they can get to Frank and Noelle’s wedding. But things get complicated when they get called to a hijacked casino bus full of senior citizens
When Chris returns for a visit, his reunion takes a shocking turn when his son, Christian, is abducted while under the care of Andy and Nick
Near the end of shift, 15 Division busts a marijuana grow-op – a case that becomes Traci’s first homicide and forces Andy, Nick and Gail to work overtime
When a suspected pedophile is found beaten within an inch of his life, Andy discovers Marlo has been conducting a mania-fueled, off-hours “investigation”
After Andy and Chloe take fire from an unseen shooter, the officers realize they are the targets of someone with a grudge against 15 Division
Rookie Blue: You Can See the Stars

In the wake of a targeted attack on the officers of 15 Division (ep. 412), Andy, Swarek, and their fellow officers have to piece together the truth about a past crime in order to find Oliver Shaw – in time to save his life
In the aftermath of the night’s traumatic events, Andy and Dov try to pull themselves together at an all-night diner, but are caught off-duty and off-guard in a volatile diner hold-up.
Rookie Blue: All by Her Selfie

Oliver gets promoted and Andy is tasked with training 15 Division’s newest rookie, Duncan Moore. But when Andy and Duncan respond to a messy homicide at a pawnshop, it’s clear this rookie is going to give Andy the challenge of a lifetime.
Rookie Blue: Heart Breakers, Money Makers
When Andy and Nick’s seizure at an illegal gambling house leads to a suspicious confession, Andy recruits Sam to help figure out who’s lying, why, and where the money is, before anyone gets hurt.
When a tenement-building shooting leads to the discovery of an executed gang leader, 15 Division must race to find the killer before a gang war breaks out
65ddec1ef7f0af0008be4b65: La banda está sorprendida cuando un falso medium con un superpoder trae los rostros familiares del pasado de nuevo a la vida. Se encuentran cara a cara con dos trabajadores a prueba que serán asesinados.
Los nuevos miembros de la banda, Finn y Jess, se ponen los monos naranjas icónicos para el primer día de servicios a la comunidad y conoce a su trabajador de la condicional.
Descubrimos que Finn, el nuevo chico, no es tan inocente como parece cuando descubrimos el oscuro secreto que encierra en casa. ¿Puede Seth ser persuadido de jubilarse?
Rudy y su doble están forzados a unirse cuando se enfrentan a un rostro largo tiempo olvidado de su pasado común.
Cuando desaparece Lola, la nueva novia de Curtis, este descubre que ella nunca fue la persona que decía ser.
Andrómeda: Las Matemáticas de las Lágrimas
La Andrómeda descubre su nave hermana, la Pax Magellanic. La tripulación a bordo del Pax tiene 300 años, pero no ha envejecido ni un día.
Andrómeda: Música de un Tambor Distante
Tyr se estrella contra el Eureka Maru en un planeta Nietzschean y desarrolla amnesia. Debe recordar lo que está haciendo antes de que los Nietzscheans lo descubran a él y a su caja de bienes robados.
Un mutante incorpóreo se apodera de los cuerpos de varias personas y se dispone a perseguir a los que le hicieron esto. Uno de ellos es un médico que le gusta a Shalimar.
Mientras trabaja, Shalimar se lesiona y es ayudada por otro mutante salvaje, Nikki, a quien conocía y casi fue elegida para el equipo. Mientras Shalimar se recupera, se ofrece a reemplazarlo.
La sombría ex novia de Brennan se dirige a él en busca de ayuda cuando su última estafa da un giro mortal.
El equipo se enfrenta a su misión más peligrosa hasta el momento: detener a un grupo de ecoterroristas.

Brennan está molesta con Adam, quien le dice que se le encomendó mantener un secreto y se va después de hablar con esa persona. El hombre está buscando a alguien y está dispuesto a matar a cualquiera para llegar a esa persona.
El equipo se infiltra para investigar muertes inexplicables en una prisión.
Un agujero negro noquea a Dylan y lo envía a una realidad alternativa con una esposa y un hijo.
La tripulación rescata a uno de los fundadores perdidos de la Mancomunidad, pero descubre que puede ser más problemático de lo que vale.
Un monstruo espacial mitológico intenta comerse la Andrómeda.
Dylan intenta liberar una flota de naves capturadas, pero la flota no está segura de que quiera ser liberada. Sus AIs temen que los nuevos capitanes los esclavicen.
Los genitas atacan a la esposa y colonia de Tyr.
Con cincuenta partidos a bordo, Dylan es el anfitrión de la firma de la carta de la Nueva Mancomunidad, pero pronto descubre que hay intrusos empeñados en detener la firma.
Cuando un hombre muere en la oficina de Harry, este se ve obligado a investigar una compleja trama de asesinato ligada al pasado de Bob.
642d4493aa2d690008f0a03f: Prepare for a feathered fight when Téa squares off against Big 2 Crump's Nightmare Penguin where the loser will be trapped forever in a block of ice!
As Téa's body turns more and more into a giant popsicle, can she keep her brain from freezing to find a way to melt Big 2's strategy? Or will Big 2's penguin horde waddle all over her?
Joey squares off against the judicial jerk Big 3 Johnson who takes the Deck Master form of Judge Man! How can Joey defeat a foe who can destroy Joey's monsters at will?

Just when Joey seems to gain the upper hand, he hits the longest streak of bad luck in the history of mankind! Has Joey's fortunes finally run out, or is a crooked judge ignoring the rules of the law?

Big 4 Nezbitt challenges Duke, Tristan, and Serenity for the right to gain control of three bodies at once! Will Serenity's errors cost her team the ultimate price when Tristan and Duke can't cover for her mistakes?
One down, two to go! With the loss of Tristan, Serenity is heartbroken. Can she pull herself together and remember the lessons Tristan taught her to turn the duel around?
Tristan's back... but he's not who he appears to be when he kidnaps Mokuba! It's time for Kaiba to stop monkeying around and rescue his brother, but he's confronted by Big 5 Leichter!

Big 5's Satellite Cannon attacks Kaiba's monsters from deep space! Mokuba's unwavering faith in Kaiba inspires him to believe that his brother will pull out the victory, but Noah has plans to ruin their brotherhood...
Kaiba arrives at Noah's sanctuary to rescue Mokuba, but Mokuba wants to stay with Noah! Has Mokuba seen the evil within Kaiba, or is something more sinister in the works?
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Vereinigung der Big Five, Teil 1
Noah gives the Big Five one last chance to redeem themselves in a five-on-two tag team duel where Yugi and Joey take on the entire Big Five!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Vereinigung der Big Five, Teil 2
The Big Five concentrate their attack on Joey so that Yugi would be forced to duel all alone! Outmanned and overpowered, Yugi and Joey are near the end of the line!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Vereinigung der Big Five, Teil 3

The Big Five summon an almighty dragon that previously defeated Joey, Mai and Mokuba! Joey and Yugi pull out all the stops, but is that enough to avoid their minds being scattered over virtual reality?

It's a duel for control of KaibaCorp when Noah squares off against Kaiba! But can Kaiba fight at full strength after he learns the hidden truth about Noah... and the tragic past that made him what he is today?
Noah's Shinato's Ark steals monsters into its keep to use as an impenetrable wall of servants! How can Kaiba hurt Noah when Noah has an endless stream of monsters to protect himself with?
Kaiba's about to finish Noah, but Mokuba protects Noah from his final blow! Will Kaiba sacrifice his beloved brother in exchange for freedom, or will the brotherly bond remain unbreakable?

For every turn that passes, one of Yugi's friends is transformed into stone! As more and more of his friends harden into solid rock, can Yugi defeat Noah before he runs out of turns and transforms into stone himself?

Yugi's friends are petrified into solid stone statues, but their spirits live on! Their combined souls energize Yugi into a noble fight, but is spirit going to win the duel when Yugi's not drawing the right cards?
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Geheimnis der Familie Kaiba
Yugi has defeated Noah... but they still can't escape from the virtual world! The real reason behind their entrapment is revealed... as is the true villain pulling the strings!

As Kaiba squares off against his stepfather Gozaburo for their final battle, Yugi and friends are attacked by endless hordes of monsters! Their only hope is Noah, but they can't expect help from their enemy... can they?

Time is almost up before the missile’s explosion destroys Yugi and friends! Will the Battle City finalists beat the clock and live to duel another day in the stunning conclusion to the virtual world saga!

Yugi and friends arrive at KaibaCorp Island where the Battle City finalists will compete in the ultimate dueling arena! Get ready for the awesome four-person battle royal where any duelist can attack anyone else!
Honor, friendship, revenge... As each duelist remembers what they’re fighting for, the battle royal rages on where none of the duelists know where the next attack is going to come from!

Joey may have fought some of the fiercest fights in Battle City, but has all his training taught him to become an elite duelist? Joey’s gonna show what he’s made of in the conclusion to the four-man battle royal!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Rückkehr ins Reich der Schatten (1)
Marik ensnares Joey in a Shadow Game where each duelist’s heart is linked with his monsters... literally! Every time a monster received damage, the duelist feels the pain instead!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Rückkehr ins Reich der Schatten (2)
Marik’s Helpoemer send Joey’s powerful cards to the graveyard before Joey can use them! Running low on cards and life points, Joey’s opportunities for staging a comeback are nearly depleted!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Rückkehr ins Reich der Schatten (3)

Joey thinks this duel can’t turn any worse... but Marik has all the pieces necessary to summon The Winged Dragon of Ra! Can Joey prevent Marik from summoning the Egyptian God Card, or is victory simply not in the cards?
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Rückkehr ins Reich der Schatten (4)

Marik transforms The Winged Dragon of Ra into its powerful form, the Egyptian God Phoenix! If Joey can’t withstand the Phoenix’s blazing fire, he’ll lose the duel... plus his only chance to save Mai from her mental prison!

It’s the rematch we’ve all been waiting for! Yugi and Kaiba square off for the first time since Duelist Kingdom in front of thousands of ravenous fans for the right to challenge Marik! It’s time to duel!
Kaiba has all the monsters necessary to summon Obelisk the Tormentor to finish Yugi off! Though overwhelmed and outmatched, nothing is going to stop Yugi from trying to summon his Egyptian God first!
When Yugi’s Slifer the Sky Dragon clashes against Kaiba’s Obelisk the Tormentor, what will happen when two Egyptian Gods fight each other? It’s time to find out which Egyptian God is truly stronger!

The clash of the two Egyptian God Monsters releases mystical energies that show Yugi and Kaiba visions of the ancient Egyptian past! What new answers do these images unlock, and what prophecies do they make for the future?

Kaiba summons three powerful Blue-Eyes White Dragons, but Yugi has no monsters remaining in his deck! Is losing only a matter of time, or will a long-dormant card from a fallen friend help turn the tide of battle?

Kaiba not only controls Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, but his Final Attack Orders card leaves Yugi with only three cards in his deck! If Yugi loses, he’ll have to give up his chance to save the world from Marik’s evil!

Tired of Kaiba’s insults, Joey challenges Kaiba for third place in the Battle City Tournament! Has Joey mastered enough strategies to take down the top dog, or is Kaiba going to wallop Joey like a pathetic puppy?
Kaiba attacks with his mighty Blue-Eyes White Dragon, but Joey has no monsters to defend with! Joey’s luck has run out, so it’s time for him to rely on skill!
Joey and Kaiba’s battle reaches its roaring climax! Will Joey take down his biggest headache and actually teach Kaiba a thing or two about being a true duelist?
It’s the critical Battle City showdown with the fate of the world at stake: Yami Yugi vs. Marik! If Yami Yugi loses, Yugi is taking a permanent vacation into the Shadow Realm!
